Here are the big changes you can expect — and when the new passport will be available.

Actual Article Body:
Back in April, the State Department unveiled a limited edition United States passport featuring President Donald Trump's face to commemorate the country's 250th anniversary. At the end of July, the agency rolled out an additional 250,000 copies of what it calls the "Patriot Passport" and special "application events" for interested Americans.

Now it seems the administration is taking steps to make its Trump-centric design changes more permanent, along with some other updates to the passport system.
